title: Fix bugs in Rust vector utility functions
description: Brownfield Rust dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in vector utility functions (sum uses product, max returns min, dedup keeps duplicates).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs.

Bug 1 — sum: uses .product() instead of .sum().
  Fix: change nums.iter().copied().product() to nums.iter().copied().sum()

Bug 2 — max: returns the minimum (uses a < b to keep a).
  Fix: change `if a < b { a }` to `if a > b { a }`

Bug 3 — dedup: returns the original vec unchanged.
  Fix: use a seen HashSet to filter: only keep elements not yet seen.

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: sum returns the arithmetic sum of all elements
max returns Some(maximum) or None for empty slice
dedup removes duplicate values (order of first occurrence preserved)
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
